integrity: Exact graph and oriented chain enumeration, all-positive unit invariant factors, and all 16 signed symmetry traces are reproducible from the provided checker. Scientific originality retains unindexed-source risk.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the 20-vertex C4-square-P5 graph; the equivariant decomposition is rational and does not address other cylinders or the integral quotient. Independent audit is not yet performed. Some potentially relevant manuscripts were accessible only by abstract.
title: Five-layer square-cylinder perfect-matching complex: 88 four-spheres and the full symmetry character
